placements.title: Architecture decisions for infrastructure and data systems
placements.theme: The organization's architectural choices — database platforms, data pipelines, and the infrastructure underpinning analytics — form a legible category of strategic decisions.

placements.title: PostgreSQL to QuantumDB for order-of-magnitude analytics performance
placements.theme: Migrating the analytics pipeline database from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB to achieve 10x query performance at lower licensing cost, targeted for Q3 2026.
placements.why: All four segments cohere under one thematic direction: the decision to migrate the analytics database for dramatic performance gains and cost savings. src-1 is the primary assertion (switch, 10x, lower cost); src-2 restates the migration; src-3 isolates the performance gain as supporting evidence; src-4 supplies the timeline. The performance figure and the timeline are facts that evidence the migration theme, not separate leaves. No existing leaf plausibly holds this theme, so it is minted.
